plugin.name: PM2 Dashboard
plugin.description: A dedicated PM2 menu with application metrics across your servers.

tab.title: PM2
tab.error: Connection lost — the values below are stale. Retrying automatically.
tab.failed: Could not load the host list
tab.automatic: Automatic updates every 5 seconds while this page is visible
tab.paused: Paused while this page is hidden
tab.pending: Automatic Abide updates will activate after the scheduled server repair tonight.

use.title: View PM2 dashboard
use.description: View PM2 metrics, process details and application logs for hosts you can access.

abide.label: Automatically update Abide
abide.description: Enable after the scheduled PM2 helper repair has been verified. Until then, automatic status requests could start a stopped manager.

detail.title: Process details
detail.unavailable: Process details unavailable. The process may have restarted.
detail.noProcess: The previous PID is no longer running. Waiting for the next PM2 sample.

logs.title: Live logs
logs.rotation: The log changed or rotated; showing the latest available lines.
logs.partial: Some source labels were unavailable; those lines are marked Unclassified.
logs.tail: Starts with the latest 200 lines per stream; keeps up to 2,000 lines in this view. Combined lines are labeled by source; initial history is grouped by file.
logs.notLive: Log data is stale until the connection resumes.
logs.readingHistoryHint: Scroll to the bottom to follow new logs, or jump to the latest.
logs.copyKeyboardHint: Use ⌘C to copy the selected logs.
logs.bufferSummary: 200 recent lines per stream · up to 2,000 lines in this view
logs.applicationOutput: Application output only · Page visits appear in web access logs

list.title: PM2 overview
list.subtitle: Your applications, at a glance. Open any process to inspect metrics and live logs.
list.search: Find an app, status, or PID…

history.title: Usage history
history.collecting: Collecting real samples… Hover or use arrow keys to inspect.
history.session: Last 10 minutes of this open session · gaps mark disconnects or process restarts · hover to inspect
